name: Cold-Email Sender Blocker
description: Stops cold-email tools from filling the CRM with junk. Any company or contact created from a blocked sending domain is removed within a couple of minutes, and the block list you keep in Settings is copied out to everyone on the team.

name: Company Tag → Deal Board
description: Tag a company with a client type and its deal shows up on the matching board within about two minutes. Delete the deal from a board and the tag comes back off, so removals stick.

name: Call Notes into the CRM
description: Collects the Gemini notes Google Meet writes after your calls, files a summary onto the matching company, contact and deal, and queues any action items for you to approve on the Calls tab.

name: CRM Backup — Nightly
description: Takes a complete copy of the CRM database at 03:15 each night and keeps the last 14 days. This is the only backup of your CRM: if it stops, there is no second copy.

name: “Last Contacted” Updater
description: Every morning it works out when you last exchanged email with each company and writes it onto the deal in plain words — today, 3 days ago, no contact logged. It only runs overnight, so today's emails show up tomorrow.

name: Draft Email Cleanup
description: The CRM mistakes every autosave of a draft reply for an email you actually sent. This clears out those phantom emails each hour so the history on a contact stays truthful.

name: Finance Backup — Nightly
description: A nightly copy of the Finance app's database, which is entirely separate from the CRM's and needs its own backup.

name: This Dashboard
description: The site you are looking at. A read-only view of everything running, plus the Calls tab where you approve action items from your calls.

name: Finance App
description: The finance site at fin.nobridge.co: cost and income submissions, the approval queue, and payment tracking.

name: Web Traffic Router
description: Points each web address at the right application and handles the padlock on the browser bar. Everything public depends on it — if this stops, all three sites go down together.

name: CRM Custom Look
description: Our branding and layout fixes painted over the standard CRM — the logo, the workspace switcher, the link across to Finance. Appearance only; the CRM underneath is the untouched official product.

name: Website Sign-up Capture
description: When somebody signs up on nobridge.co a deal is created in the CRM automatically and marked as coming from Sign Ups. This one runs on the website's host rather than our server, so its health cannot be checked from here.
